item.title: Software Architecture in a Digital Society
item.content:encoded:
This special issue of the Journal of Systems and Software explores the role of software architecture in addressing contemporary challenges within an increasingly digital society. The issue invites research examining how architectural approaches can support and adapt to the demands of modern digital transformation.
